en: Vintage monochrome view over a wooded valley with a curving railway line in the foreground and a hilltop town in the background. The town shows several multi‑storey historic buildings and a large church with a tall spire dominating the skyline. Industrial structures, including what appears to be a gas holder, are visible on the slope. At the top left in red print is the caption 'Leisnig i. S.'. The image has the typical framing and print style of early 20th‑century European postcards.
